subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Cloud marketplace / reseller purchase path for Greenline
messages:

Subject: MAP kickoff: Greenline marketplace + reseller purchase path

Hi Aisha / Greenline team —

Following up from Friday’s intro call. Attaching the initial MAP (MAP_Greenline_v3.xlsx) and a one-page marketplace checklist — these capture the items we discussed: marketplace listing cadence (AWS first), reseller contract terms, procurement milestones, and required artifacts for reseller onboarding.

Proposed high-level milestones:
- Week 1: Confirm marketplace listing owner + provide marketplace artifacts (logo, images, billing contact)
- Week 2: Reseller SOW and procurement PO window; CloudResell to confirm resale terms
- Week 3: Marketplace listing review & QA; internal eval plan completed
- Week 4: Go-live (soft) and finance routing for billing via marketplace

Please review the MAP and flag any missing pieces. Key asks for this week:
1) Greenline: confirm procurement owner who will issue PO (name + email)
2) CloudResell: confirm reseller terms + EULA alignment
3) Redwood: commit to marketplace artifact delivery date (we’ve tentatively assigned Vanessa)

I’ve scheduled a weekly checkpoint cadence — next meeting Tue 2027-04-13 11:00 PT (invite attached).

Thanks,
Marcus

Thanks Marcus — quick MAP checkpoint / notes before Tue:

- Marketplace artifacts: In progress. Assets owner: Vanessa. ETA for final assets: 2027-04-15.
- Reseller terms: waiting on CloudResell confirmation (see email thread below).
- Eval plan: Redwood will deliver an eval set and performance baseline by 2027-04-14. Camila owns the eval plan.

Action items (owner / due):
- Aisha (Greenline) — confirm procurement owner: name+email (due 2027-04-13)
- CloudResell (partners@cloudresell.com) — provide reseller MSA excerpt and margin matrix (due 2027-04-14)

- If reseller margin matrix is delayed, pricing alignment could push the PO window by 1–2 weeks.

—Vanessa

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Greenline marketplace + reseller purchase path

Hi Marcus / Vanessa —

Thanks for the invite; overview from our side below. We can support Greenline’s purchase via AWS Marketplace (standard listing) or by processing a reseller invoice (if needed). For the marketplace route we need the following artifacts to begin internal onboarding:
- Full product blurb + 2 screenshots (web + admin)
- SKU mapping and pricing table (USD)
- Technical contact for integration and testing (email)
- Signed reseller addendum (we can provide a template)

Timelines we can commit to (assuming artifacts received):
- Onboarding intake -> CloudResell review: 3 business days
- Reseller addendum review & redline: 4–6 business days
- Marketplace submission / AWS review: 7–10 business days (may vary)

We attached our onboarding requirements doc (CloudResell_Onboarding_Reqs.docx). We recommend Greenline confirm whether they prefer marketplace billing (via AWS) or reseller invoicing — both have tradeoffs for procurement.

Regards,
Tom Ellis | Channel Ops, CloudResell LLC
partners@cloudresell.com
Attachments: CloudResell_Onboarding_Reqs.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, CloudResell LLC <partners@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Greenline Procurement <procurement@greenline.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Greenline marketplace + reseller purchase path

Quick follow-up on pricing/PO mechanics from finance: 

- If Greenline purchases via AWS Marketplace standard listing, revenue recognition is straightforward but Greenline needs to accept AWS terms and may require private pricing. Our SKU mapping will need to include both list price and marketplace list price.
- If they prefer reseller invoicing, CloudResell will handle billing but there is a 5–7 business day settlement lag; finance requires PO + signed reseller addendum before provisioning.

Pricing options (next steps I’ll own):
- Provide two SKU options (metered vs fixed subscription) and recommended default for Greenline (due 2027-04-16).
- Prepare a short pricing memo for Greenline procurement outlining tax/billing implications (due 2027-04-16).

Action owners recap (from finance / ops lens):
- Vanessa: finalize marketplace artifacts (due 2027-04-15)
- Camila: upload eval baseline (due 2027-04-14)
- Tom / CloudResell: return reseller addendum + margin matrix (due 2027-04-14)
- Aisha / Greenline: confirm PO owner + PO target date (due 2027-04-13) — still outstanding
- Rishi: pricing memo and SKU mapping (due 2027-04-16)

Note to Greenline: if you can sign the reseller addendum this week and confirm PO timing, we can target a soft go-live via AWS marketplace the week of 2027-04-26.

—Rishi
